_note: Cultures (in culture groups), ethnicities and religions. A province whose culture isn't accepted by its owner gets unrest; a different culture group or ethnicity adds more. Religions give their followers' nations modifiers. Names other than Pigs, Pigmen, Humans, Angels and the Will of Eden are placeholders.

Pigman.text: Pigmen: upright, clever, often found in the labs and mines.

Human.text: Skyfallin humans. They need breathing masks below the clouds.

Lotus Faith.text: The faith of the Holy Empire (placeholder name).

Will of Eden.text: Skyfall's devotion to Eden, who raised the islands.

Mud Spirits.text: The old ways of the wild boars (placeholder).

Black Moon.text: Worship of the Doomsday Portal and the Black Moon that opens it. The anomalies spare the faithful.

separatists.name: Separatists
separatists.text: Want their land out of the empire.

zealots.name: Religious zealots
zealots.text: Want their province to follow their faith.

peasants.name: Peasant revolt
peasants.text: Angry about taxes, war and hunger.

entities.name: Entities
entities.text: Things from beyond the Doomsday Portal. They answer to no one, and time reversing does not send them back.
